text:
alice: Heads up — nightly SAST (main branch) flagged a high severity issue in payments-sdk v2.3 (generated proto serialization). CI link: https://ci.redwood/incoming/8921

alice: Failing presubmit and blocking the release candidate.

david: Hmm, I think this started after yesterday's keystore binding change. I saw a 403 in the signing service logs. Could be a CI artifact generation difference.

incident-bot: incident created INC-4521 — subject: sast-failure-payments-sdk

erin: Reproduced locally. Minimal stack:
```
panic: proto: unexpected type in marshal
  at generated/payment.pb.go:420
  at proto/encoding.go:67
```

frank: Initial triage: likely FP (generated code), but we need exploitability proof. If there's a runtime path, escalate. Also need KMS audit entries for binding change window.

grace: Pulled KMS audit logs — found two binding updates at 2025-05-17T03:14:22Z and 03:14:45Z. Excerpt:
`admin.setIamPolicy: principal=infra-service@redwood, role=roles/keystore.signer, change=ADD`
`admin.setIamPolicy: principal=ci-builder@redwood, role=roles/keystore.viewer, change=REMOVE`
No errors otherwise.

alice: Can infra provide the full audit bundle (request/response ids) so we can cross-check CI runs that used the old vs new bindings?

david: I can map CI run IDs to service accounts. give me the run IDs and I’ll check which signer was used.

erin: Ran a quick exploit harness against a dev instance — cannot reproduce a hostile payload. DAST scheduled for full run (ETA 45m).

frank: Until DAST completes, don't suppress the rule. If DAST comes back clean and we confirm it's generated-only, we'll file suppression with evidence.

alice: Action items:
- grace: upload KMS audit bundle to INC-4521
- david: correlate CI run IDs -> signer identity
- erin: share DAST report
- frank: prepare suppression rationale template if needed

sre-bot: created ticket #SRE-3129 to keep an eye on deploys during this window.

alice: tagging @eric (payments) for visibility — assigning owner once DAST result in.

eric (payments): thx, will monitor and help dig next 2 hours. If DAST shows anything, escalate to oncall immediately.

alice: OK, summarizing: we keep release blocked until we confirm non-exploitable or have a plan. Will post updates in INC-4521. :thumbsup:
